boundary: Unchanged released Yours5.1.0 window.CWI plus visible permission prompts and Settings→Permissions controls. No extension messaging, IndexedDB reads, private grants, privileged roots or alternate keyrings.
grantSemantics: Protocol, basket and certificate approvals are persisted by the admitted LocalWalletPermissionsManager in its local permission store. Reactive spending consent is deliberately one-shot; only manifest/grouped consent creates a monthly spending allowance.
scope: Basket explicit denial, explicit approval and subsequent cached access to a real native-created output.
Certificate-field explicit denial, approval and cached proof; independently verify issuer signature, native subject identity, exactly one disclosed field and 32-byte field key.

Spending explicit denial with no submission matching the customer payment script and amount, explicit approval of a real independently proven signed payment, and a subsequent payment requiring fresh consent again. Unrelated background receipts remain in the complete window.
Single visible basket-grant revocation, renewed prompt denial, separately approved recovery and cached recovered access; certificate grant remains available.

Visible origin-wide revoke-all plus confirmation, renewed basket/certificate prompts and rejection, original protocol grant no longer available; another origin retains its independently granted matching basket and protocol.
All assertions join the original native identity; signed transactions and global submission-window indices are retained for parent independent funding/storage joins.
Close only owned application/settings/prompt pages; parent retires the whole admitted browser and controlled services.
limits: No finite-expiry UI exists in the admitted prompt; no expiry enforcement claim.
Grouped standing monthly spending budgets and counterparty pacts are separate unexecuted scopes.
No privileged-mode, secondary keyring, on-chain permission-token, physical USB or full permission-category completeness claim.
Original eight V005 predicates and historical reports remain unchanged; this is an opt-in additive report executed after the existing integration graph.
historicalPolicy: Version1 manifests, raw failed native7 reports and frozen journal replay remain unchanged. This version corrects the observer causal boundary without changing permission, identity, payment or revocation acceptance criteria.
setup: ToDo-origin setup may approve its visible manifest/grouped request using Allow Selected; the primary and alternate test origins have no manifest standing allowance. The16 reported category/revocation predicates operate on those independent origins.

observer.controls: Passive document capture listener, armed before the ordinary Playwright visible button click. No event synthesis, cancellation, propagation changes, private grants or extension messaging.
observer.join: Distinct public request nonce binds the retained original CWI promise, matching popup/main-frame/button event, trusted left-click capture timestamp, host receipt timestamp and actual terminal native result. Click observation nonces cannot be reused.
observer.closure: A target-closed Playwright transport error is retained separately. PASS still requires the actual trusted matching DOM click and subsequent real native terminal result; popup closure alone, missing event, synthetic events, timeout and unrelated errors cannot pass.
observer.timing: Native settlement may precede completion of the Playwright click promise. It must follow the actual DOM dispatch. Every timestamp is retained, including host receipt and automation completion.
observer.default: Version1 remains the default producer behavior; prospective 2.0 wiring explicitly selects trustedClick:true.
